items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: She was a secretary then. She's a school teacher. Smart. Very smart woman.

ctx.x: No, Miss, uh, where we went Sunday. His daughter. Miss Talton, it says. Talton. Talton. Talton. Talton. Talton. Talton. Maybe we went Sunday. She was a secretary then. She's a school teacher. Smart. Very smart woman. Very smart woman. And, uh, tell me when you get tired. Well, I think after this reel, but we still got some more time on it. Well, all right then. I don't know how tired you're getting. I am not. Just go on. We got tired.

Just let me know. This is Ms. Brown, Deborah Brown's mother's bed. Four-poster bed like I was telling you my grandmother had. But hers was even larger than this. You see those old-time four-poster beds. We took a picture of that when we were visiting her. I think you've seen this one.
